summary: A static Next.js site on GitHub Pages, with this agent served from a Cloudflare Worker. The site's code is part of the portfolio, so it's public.

sections.label: Frontend
points: Next.js App Router with a static export, React 19 and strict TypeScript.
The landing page is fully server-rendered HTML, so it works with JavaScript off.
CSS Modules on design tokens; every accent shade derives from a single --accent variable via color-mix().
CSS scroll-driven animations for the timeline parallax and Motion springs for cards entering the chat, all off under prefers-reduced-motion.

sections.label: Agent
points: CopilotKit's runtime speaks AG-UI from a Cloudflare Worker; the chat is a custom headless UI.
MiniMax M3 behind a provider adapter, with OpenRouter as the fallback.
Tools read the same typed content the cards render and return ids, so the model never free-writes job titles, dates or quotes.
Recommendation excerpts are only shown if they appear verbatim in the source text.

sections.label: Content
points: One source of truth: typed JSON and Markdown validated by Zod; invalid content fails the build.
A Claude Code skill syncs the résumé from a private repo, keeping ids stable.
Condensed card copy is fingerprinted against the résumé text, so it can't silently go stale.

sections.label: Quality
points: Biome, Vitest and Playwright in GitHub Actions, including automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks with axe.
